Lexical Semantic Change Detection (SCD) task involves predicting whether a given target word, $w$, changes its meaning between two different text corpora, $C_1$ and $C_2$.
For this purpose, we propose a supervised two-staged SCD method that uses existing Word-in-Context (WiC) datasets.
